title: Hytale 0.7.2 scoped terrain editing through ECS sections with native restart and selective region merge
summary: Native scoped Hytale 0.7.2 editing now includes continuous farm-hill reconstruction, supported native reforestation and an Adaptive Surface retrofit resolved by the installed Topology. Native restart and component-preservation checks passed; client performance was not benchmarked.
problem_description: Legacy WorldChunk block and height APIs no longer compile on the installed release. A native editing and inspection path must load complete sections safely, preserve multipart roots/fillers and unrelated saved entities, and install only authorized terrain records.
context: Blackridge grain fields on a freshly backed-up user-expanded Working Copy. Same enabled mods as live, no players, frozen isolated test server; 10 irregular plots and one asset-only dark wheat variant. Client UI control was not used. Later landscape work used explicit authorization to modify the installed Working Copy, with a fresh backup, closed client world and temporary native bridge. Native second-pass validation covered 107058190 changed cells; the subsequent 608-distance revision is tracked separately in project memory.
capabilities_required: load and pin ECS chunk sections
constraints: Revalidate API/schema against the actual installed release, not a remembered version
No live-file writes while game/server is open
Do not equate native server tests or approximate previews with user visual approval
Direct authoring of an installed map needs explicit user authorization and a closed client world; otherwise use an isolated copy.
The grain-field v001 kept bounded lifetime section pins; landscape v002 releases all column and section pins per operation.
Keep native persistence proof, client visual evidence, and performance claims separate.

solution_versions.description: Use a version-checked ECS compatibility adapter for native reads/writes, keep all test-area chunk sections loaded during inspection, then merge only changed native chunk records into original region files and reopen the merged candidates before live installation.
changes: Load ChunkStore references and section references asynchronously; read BlockSection, FluidSection, BlockComponentSection and HeightmapColumn instead of removed WorldChunk methods
Use native BlockOperations.setBlock and explicitly validate multipart filler offsets, rotations and supported roots
Retain a bounded cache of loaded columns and their ten sections for the isolated server lifetime, with balanced additional per-operation pins
Whitelist removal of 5435 obsolete agricultural block components; retain other original block and non-block entities
Copy original region files, replace only 33 selected records, restore protected entity data, and verify every unselected record byte-for-byte
Reopen merged candidates under the same mods, inspect 500 section tiles, compare all surveyed cells, then deploy two region files plus one explicit new asset pack and its configuration enable
advantages: Does not reinstall stale pre-user-edit map geometry
Version-specific native validation makes multipart and persistence defects observable
All unselected chunk records and unrelated live files preserved
disadvantages: Test-server lifetime pins consume memory; do not reuse unchanged as an unbounded production service
No actual client walkthrough or manual harvest/interaction test
Native serialization and APIs must be checked on each game release
test_results: 74048 changed block cells across 33 chunks; zero mismatch, unplanned or protected-area differences after final restart
12514 golden wheat roots and 45 dark wheat roots retained; zero unsupported planned roots; fluids identical
20/20 field entrances reachable in geometric navigation checks; no path step greater than one block
496 unrelated block components and 73210 original non-block entity sections identical; only 5435 explicitly obsolete farm components removed
2009 existing unselected chunk records byte-identical within the two deployment regions
5921 other preexisting live files byte-identical; no existing shared/world mod changes; world/player config unchanged
New pack loads and places successfully under native release 0.7.2; user visual approval remains pending

metrics.reliability: Recorded native save/restart, component and checksum assertions passed; not a client visual certification

solution_versions.description: Scale native Hytale 0.7.2 terrain editing with per-operation ECS section pins, exact desired-state plans, preloaded surface variants and component-level region preservation. Reopen the preserved save and compare complete block, rotation, filler, entity and fluid snapshots.
changes: Release column and all ten section pins after each bounded operation instead of retaining the full landscape in memory.
Normalize native palette indices by stable asset names across server restarts.
Use already loaded Adaptive Surface variants and stock tree prefabs; do not register assets at runtime.
Generate complete desired block state before native application, pilot representative chunks and compare native readback.
Retain original root metadata and all section components except Block and BlockPhysics; update HeightmapColumn only.
When direct editing of the installed map is explicitly authorized, use one writer, fresh backups, zero-player authoring, and remove the temporary bridge after validation.
advantages: Validated at landscape scale without pinning every surveyed chunk simultaneously.
All original foreign chunk components and unselected region records retained.
Native readback catches multipart filler and ordering defects that visual plans cannot detect.
disadvantages: Only the installed Hytale 0.7.2 revision was validated.
A geometrically correct distant landscape can still exceed the client view-distance budget; actual screenshots are a separate acceptance step.
Single screenshots and 60 FPS overlays are not a controlled performance benchmark.
test_results: Second pass: 107058190 changed cells across 1896 chunks; 621281280 cells compared after save and after reopening, with zero errors.
2199 unselected existing chunk records byte-identical; 113760 original foreign section components retained.
Three scenic villages with 19 houses, native tree prefabs and 102539 terrain Adaptive Surface variants were persisted.
A two-chunk tall-grass pilot initially failed; replacement with the verified single-cell native lush tall grass passed, followed by full save/reopen validation.

metrics.reliability: Native complete-state and selective-preservation checks passed; client visual acceptance is tracked separately.

solution_versions.description: Rebuild a localized Hytale 0.7.2 hill as continuous supported terrain, replant native trees on the final heightfield, remove unsupported natural components, then retrofit the slope with variants resolved by the installed Adaptive Surface Topology while leaving full terrain and trees unchanged.
changes: Scope the deleted hill by comparing the current native blocks to the prior approved save; protect fields, buildings and unrelated landscape.

Fill each reconstructed terrain column to its existing foundation before placing any vegetation. Remove affected old native tree prefabs first, then place new native tree prefabs at final ground height.
Detect detached natural blocks with 26-neighbour connectivity anchored to ground, target boundaries and protected construction.

For the cosmetic pass, use the installed ZytaleAdaptiveSurface 0.9.5 Topology.resolve and registered material variants above full native soil; retain grass clusters and relocate supported single-cell plants.

Validate explicit before/after block plans against native exports, restart the save, compare every selected cell, and selectively merge only Block, BlockPhysics and HeightmapColumn into original region records.
advantages: Continuous playable-side climb and an exterior concave face with forested native vegetation.
No changes to protected crops, architecture, existing trees or full terrain during the Adaptive Surface pass.
Native restart and support checks detect floating remnants, unsupported roots and mismatched material variants.
disadvantages: Validated for this installed 0.7.2 map and Adaptive Surface 0.9.5, not other releases.
Cosmetic slopes displaced some tall grass: local undergrowth count changed from 13,024 to 5,718 despite relocating 643 plants.
No new client capture or measured FPS benchmark was performed for these two passes.
test_results: R9 hill: 359,218 changed cells across 40 chunks; 13,107,200 complete cells matched the plan after restart; 16,005 columns supported to foundation, 448 native root contacts supported and zero disconnected components in scope.

R10 Adaptive Surface: 10,478 changed cells across 34 chunks; 11,141,120 complete cells matched after restart; 9,835 native-Topology-resolved variants supported; 55,706 tree cells and 3,336,433 full terrain cells unchanged.
After closure, temporary bridge removed and all 6,007 pre-existing nonterrain files byte-identical to the latest user save. Backup and final checkpoint manifests hash-verified.
User visual feedback after R10: «Il risultato ottenuto davvero buono» and «Ottimo lavoro». This is qualitative feedback, not a performance benchmark.

metrics.reliability: Native restart comparisons and scoped support checks passed without errors.
metrics.maintainability: Reusable validation and restoration approach; asset IDs, topology and schema require revalidation for another installation.
metrics.compatibility: Hytale 0.7.2; installed ZytaleAdaptiveSurface 0.9.5; one authorized local save.

transferability: Loading lifecycle, explicit removal allowlists and exact-record preservation are reusable principles. API names, bounds, asset IDs, serialization schema and metrics are specific to this observed 0.7.2 installation.
